principle: The work generates meaning by staging its own archaeology, serializing private experience through a fixed episode template, splitting every unit into an experience stratum and an exegesis stratum, and framing the whole as a medieval codex so that seams and truncation register as deposited evidence.

nodes.label: Two-layer stratification
nodes.description: Each chapter pairs a dated first-layer fantasy transcript with a later second-layer exegetical commentary; the raw-versus-worked split repeats fractally at page scale (text block versus painting) and book scale (calligraphic folio versus untranscribed typescript).
evidence: Nearly every chapter contains a dated fantasy transcript derived from the Black Book journals plus a retrospective commentary in a hortatory register.
The split is documented at three scales: page, chapter, and book; it passes the subtraction test explicitly in Stage 4.
Nested-reduction finding: dialogic transcript, exegetical commentary, and pictorial program are three irreducible levels.
rules: Staged rawness must remain partially concealed: both layers must appear temporally distinct while having entered the folio in one campaign

nodes.label: Codex-pastiche framing
nodes.description: Illuminated-manuscript conventions such as Gothic calligraphy, rubrication, historiated initials, gold leaf, and incipit epigraphs frame the modern content, so that seams, revisions, and truncation register as monumental evidence rather than process failure.
evidence: Incipit page with Latin and German scriptural epigraphs, historiated initials, rubrication in red, ruled text-block borders, two-column layout in portions.
A break-off in a notebook is unremarkable; a break-off mid-sentence in gold-leafed calligraphy registers as structural event.
Illumination conventionally sanctifies completed anonymous text; here the most gold-leafed material certifies the private, dated, and provisional.
rule_violations: Illumination sanctifies completed, anonymous, traditional text

nodes.label: Recurrent episode template
nodes.description: Chapters follow a serial unit of descent or arrival, encounter with a personified figure, dialogue in dramatic script, reversal or instruction, then exegesis, repeated with variation across roughly two dozen chapters.
evidence: The template repeats with variation across roughly two dozen chapters in Liber Primus and Secundus.
Descent topography supplies consistent orientation devices across otherwise disjunct episodes.
Stage 4: two dependent mechanisms identified; removing it collapses both the collision system and the closure logic.

nodes.label: Dated-entry anchoring
nodes.description: Calendar dates on first-layer transcripts establish a diaristic chronology inside the mythic material and supply the evidence that the two layers are temporally distinct strata.
evidence: First-layer fantasies carry calendar dates beginning October to December 1913.
Stage 2: the dates load-bear for the layers; without them stratification would read as mere stylistic variation.
Stage 4 notes a functional equivalent could substitute, making this supporting rather than central.

nodes.label: Distinct typographic and stylistic registers per layer
nodes.description: The first and second layers are typographically and stylistically distinct: dialogic dramatic script versus hortatory prophetic homily, with pacing correlated to layer (scene-duration versus aphoristic compression).
evidence: Stage 1: the layers are typographically and stylistically distinct.
Stage 2: whenever register shifts from dramatic script to homily, temporal grain coarsens; the alternation is rule-governed.
Stage 6: a trained reader assigns passages to strata by register and typography alone, before any date confirms it.

nodes.label: Non-corresponding full-page paintings
nodes.description: Full-page gouache and gold-leaf paintings (mandalas including Systema Munditotius, the Philemon panel, the Izdubar sequence) frequently do not illustrate adjacent text; several are dated years after the passages they face.
evidence: Meaning arises from juxtaposition of independently produced layers, a collisive operation rather than illustration.
The latest paintings are the most autonomous and most heavily worked, escalating as calligraphic execution collapses.
Stage 4: irreducible per the nested-reduction finding, but the non-correspondence is enabled by the template rather than generative itself.
rule_violations: Finish declines along the parchment-paper-typescript gradient

nodes.label: Parchment-to-paper substrate shift
nodes.description: Liber Primus is executed on parchment, Liber Secundus on paper bound into the red leather folio; the material seam coincides exactly with the sectional seam.
evidence: The material seam coincides with the Primus/Secundus sectional seam.
Stage 4 classifies it incidental: a different material marker would serve identically.
rules: Every sectional seam must be materialized in substrate or execution state

nodes.label: Untranscribed Scrutinies typescript
nodes.description: The third part, Scrutinies, was never transcribed into the calligraphic folio and exists only in typed draft, completing a gradient of diminishing material finish from parchment to paper to typescript.
evidence: The structural asymmetry is visible in the published facsimile-plus-transcription edition.
Stage 2: the untranscribed third section is systematic rather than accidental; it completes the finish gradient.
rules: Every sectional seam must be materialized in substrate or execution state

nodes.label: Septem Sermones ad Mortuos
nodes.description: Seven sermons embedded in Scrutinies, attributed to the pseudonymous ancient author Basilides of Alexandria, delivered as monologic doctrinal address to the dead, separately printed in 1916; the only finished, doctrinally closed unit in the book.
evidence: Every other unit is anchored to the first-person I; this one refuses that anchor while remaining inside the book.
Stage 3: the only finished, doctrinally closed unit in a work whose every other unit is materially or rhetorically open.
Stage 4: single instance, but it converts truncation from incapacity into refusal.
rule_violations: Every unit is anchored to the first-person dialogic I

nodes.label: Double mid-sentence truncation
nodes.description: The calligraphic transcription breaks off mid-sentence in 1930; a 1959 epilogue, added decades later, also breaks off mid-sentence. Two abandoned endings, both preserved, form the boundary condition of the work.
evidence: Blank ruled pages follow the break-off point; the production state is legible as material fact.
Stage 2: the mid-sentence break enacts materially the traversal-without-completion the template rehearses.
Stage 3: the second truncation retroactively converts the first from event into behavior; closure becomes iterable, which negates closure.
Stage 4 classifies double truncation as an effect produced by pastiche plus template plus seam-rule, not an independent mechanism.
rules: Every sectional seam must be materialized in substrate or execution state

nodes.label: Single transcription campaign behind both layers
nodes.description: Both layers entered the calligraphic volume in a single transcription campaign, in one hand: the raw first layer is a fair copy of rawness, and the dates are testimony transcribed rather than substrate evidence.
evidence: Stage 3: what reads as sedimentary is staged; the mechanism of exposed process is itself a finished artifact.
Stage 3: the dates, called load-bearing, are testimony transcribed, not substrate evidence.

edges.rationale: Stratification requires temporal markers such as dated entries to be legible as process rather than style; without calendar dates the layer split reads as mere stylistic variation.

Three-speed temporality on one opening requires typographic and register distinctions strong enough for stratum-assignment without dates; the reader detects the layer by register before any date confirms it.
Image-text non-correspondence requires the regularity of the episode template; if serial regularity decreases, pictorial looseness degrades into disorientation rather than productive collision.
Incompletion registering as content requires the pastiche frame that promises finish; without the promise there is no violation, and a mid-sentence break reads as unremarkable abandonment.
Truncation reading as refusal rather than incapacity requires at least one achieved-closure unit; the Sermones are the sole finished, doctrinally closed unit supplying that contrast.

Every sectional seam must be materialized in substrate or execution state; the parchment-to-paper shift enacts the Primus/Secundus boundary materially, reinforcing the stratified logic without being irreplaceable.
The calligraphic folio versus untranscribed typescript is the raw-versus-worked split at book scale, completing the finish gradient and extending stratification to the whole object.

The illuminated frame supplies the monumental authority the strata trade on: gold leaf and calligraphy make private, dated, provisional material read as deposited evidence rather than process failure.

The truncation is the template's final iteration executed in the register of production: episodes rehearse traversal-without-completion, and the mid-sentence break enacts it materially, giving the ending its meaning.

The Sermones abandon the first-person dialogic episode system entirely: monologic, pseudepigraphic, doctrinally closed. Rule-governed template correspondence is what allows this refusal to register as refusal.

As calligraphic finish declines along the parchment-paper-typescript gradient, pictorial elaboration intensifies; material decline and pictorial intensification cross, so the finish rule holds only per register.

The performed rawness of the first layer depends on concealing that both layers entered the folio in a single transcription campaign; the exposure the stratification performs is staged, not possessed.
The dates called load-bearing are testimony transcribed in the fair-copy campaign, not substrate evidence; the anchoring mechanism certifies a chronology it cannot itself materially prove.

failure_modes.consequence: Without dated anchors or register distinction, the layer split reads as inconsistent tone shifts rather than temporal strata; stratification loses its legibility as exposed compositional process.
If the episode template loses regularity, non-corresponding paintings produce disorientation instead of productive collision, and the truncation loses its final-iteration meaning.
Without the pastiche frame, mid-sentence break-offs and blank ruled pages read as mere abandonment, not structural events; the authority-inversion disappears and a stratified serial journal remains.
Without one instance of achieved closure, the double truncation reads as authorial incapacity rather than deliberate refusal; non-completion stops functioning as terminal statement.

violated: Staged rawness must remain partially concealed: both layers must appear temporally distinct while having entered the folio in one campaign

failure_modes.consequence: If the staging of rawness becomes fully invisible, the exposure claim turns fraudulent rather than performed; if fully exposed, the monument effect collapses. The mechanism only works held at half-visibility.

violated: Every sectional seam must be materialized in substrate or execution state

failure_modes.consequence: If seams stop being materialized in substrate or execution, section boundaries become notational and the seam-rule system loses coherence; the untranscribed third section reverts from systematic gradient to accident.

asserted_removal_tests.M1: If removed, the work collapses into either a single-genre journal or a treatise, and the seam-based identity of the object disappears.
asserted_removal_tests.M2: If removed, the mid-sentence truncation and unfinished pages revert to reading as ordinary abandonment, and the authority-inversion effect vanishes.
asserted_removal_tests.M3: If removed, the non-corresponding paintings collapse into incoherence rather than productive juxtaposition, and the truncation loses its meaning as a final template iteration.
asserted_removal_tests.M4: If removed, the stratification becomes generic stylistic variation rather than legible exposed compositional process.
